title: The One at the Bottom
subtitle: 习惯自律 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 习惯自律（生活与学习·良好习惯与自律）
meta: 主题语境：习惯自律（生活与学习·良好习惯与自律）　|　核心词汇：behaviour　|　正文 334 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 behaviour 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1958 my grandmother wrote down ① a behaviour she did not want repeated and pinned it to the door for eleven years, and my mother said the pinning was the whole of the punishment. The ② behaviour, meaning the act and not the list, was never mentioned and was never repeated; a behaviour, she said, is the only thing you can forbid without saying its name.

Every ③ behaviour on that list was written in the same hand, and the ④ behaviour at the bottom, meaning the one added in March and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever asked about. A behaviour, my father said, is nine parts habit and one part somebody noticing; my grandmother said the noticing is the part that costs.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ behaviour was the whole of the machine, meaning the way it ran and not the act. The ⑥ behaviour, meaning the performance and not any of that, is the only thing in an engine that everybody complains about and nobody can describe; a behaviour, he said, is either something you forbid or the only word that means both an act and a performance. She said the act came first.

By 1971 the ⑦ behaviour had become a word in a report, and the report had become an argument about who had written it. The ⑧ behaviour of the whole thing, my grandmother wrote in April, was nine years of pinning and one question in March; a behaviour, she said, is either the act on the door or the reason you learned to write things down. He said the writing was the part that worked.

The ⑨ behaviour I remember is the one at the bottom, which was never explained and was never removed. A ⑩ behaviour, my mother said in 1973, is the only thing that improves by being written down; every behaviour, she said, is a performance that has agreed to look like an act. She said the act was never the difficult part.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 行为（指那个举动，与那张清单相对）
C. 固定搭配：write down a behaviour 写下一种行为
D. n. 行为（指清单上每一种）
E. n. 行为（指清单底部那一条）
F. n. （机器的）性能；运转状况
G. n. 性能（抽象：运转表现这件事）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a behaviour she did not want repeated
The behaviour, meaning the act and not the list
behaviour was the whole of the machine
the behaviour had become a word in a report
The behaviour of the whole thing
A behaviour, my mother said in 1973

answers.why: write down a behaviour 意为“写下一种行为”，1958 年祖母写下一种她不愿再看到的行为，钉在门上十一年。
behaviour 意为“行为”，指那个举动而不是那张清单，它从没被提起过，也从没再发生过。
behaviour 指清单上每一种行为，每一种都是同一笔迹写的。
behaviour 指清单底部那一条（三月加上去的那一条），是唯一有人问过的。
behaviour 意为“性能、运转状况”，指那台机器的运转方式，叔叔说 behaviour 就是那台机器的全部。
behaviour 为抽象用法，指运转表现这件事，是发动机里人人都抱怨、却没人描述得出来的东西。
behaviour 意为“行为”，到 1971 年这个 behaviour 成了报告里的一个词。
behaviour 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，祖母四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九年的钉挂和三月的一个问题。
behaviour 意为“行为”，我记得的是清单底部那一条，从没被解释过，也从没被撕下来。
behaviour 为抽象总称，母亲说行为是唯一会因为被写下来而变好的东西。

那种行为，指的是那个举动而不是那张清单，从没被提起过，也从没再发生过。（behaviour）

叔叔说 behaviour 就是那台机器的全部，指的是运转状况而不是那个举动。（behaviour）

The behaviour, meaning the act and not the list, was never mentioned and was never repeated.
Every behaviour on that list was written in the same hand.
The behaviour at the bottom, meaning the one added in March and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever asked about.

A behaviour, my mother said in 1973, is the only thing that improves by being written down.
